_comment: Client ops workspaces: one Fly app per client that holds that client's documents (matter files, medical records, chronologies, anything made from them) and nothing else. Created, updated and destroyed only by bin/ops-workspace; read by the laptop launcher (laptop/ops), the daily sweep (.github/workflows/ops-workspace-sweep.yml) and decommission. smd-ops is SMD's own machine, not a client workspace, and is not listed. Handbook: docs/handbook/ops-machine.md.
